Welcome everyone. Point to the bus: Lessons 1 to 5 are ticked. Today the bus moves on to Lesson 6: Look how far we've come. It puts the whole term together, and it gives a first, small peek at the Christmas lessons (Lessons 7 and 8). The first part of this deck looks back at Lesson 5, then the whole term, then it introduces Lesson 6 before students get the worksheet. Allow about 30 to 40 minutes.

Talk about a place

Think of one place you like. Ask your partner. Answer, then add more.
1
Where is it? What's it near?
2
How often do you go there?
3
Is it open all year?
4
Is it a service, a recreation activity or a business?
Example: It's on Willoughby Road, opposite the bus stop. I go there once a week.
Term 4  ·  Explore community services
Pairs, about 5 minutes. These are the Lesson 5 discussion questions. Push "answer, then add more": a short answer plus one or two details. Ask two or three students to tell the class about their partner's place.

Your grammar toolbox

Say the verb with your partner first. Then click the blank.
1
Look! The bus (come) now.
2
I (get) my Opal card in October.
3
I (be) to the library twice.
4
Next week we (see) the Christmas lights.
Five tenses: simple present, present continuous, past simple, be going to, present perfect
Term 4  ·  Explore community services
Pairs say each sentence first, then click the blanks. Ask: which time words helped? (Look! now, in October, twice, next week.) Every tense from the term is in Stop 4 of the worksheet, with a toolbox table. Keep this short.
